tasks.title: Resolve external deps in smoke_import via extra_paths + working_dir env (NGv2 bug #2)
acceptance_criteria: smoke_import gains a keyword-only param extra_paths (default ()): each path is appended to BOTH the PYTHONPATH path_parts AND (on the jailed branch) the build_jail_argv extra_ro list, so a candidate importing an external dependency under those roots resolves.

When extra_paths is empty, smoke_import falls back to os.environ['JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR'] ONLY when it is set and not _target_is_self(working_dir); a self build (env unset or self) gains NO extra path and behaves byte-identically to today.
The scrubbed-env semantics, the _site_packages_dirs handling, the fail-closed bwrap branch, the dbus-proxy logic, and the return contract are all unchanged.

spec.objective: Close NGv2 external-build bug #2: smoke_import scrubs PYTHONPATH to [tempdir, JM project root, site-packages] and ro-binds only sys.base_prefix/sys.prefix/site-packages into the jail, so a candidate that imports an EXTERNAL dependency (e.g. `from ngv2.contracts import ...`, living under the external working_dir) is unresolvable -> smoke_failed. The smoke gate fires for bypass_fuzzer meta-types (e.g. orchestration), exactly what an Epic-2 external child uses. Thread the external dependency root(s) into BOTH the PYTHONPATH and the jail binds.
functional_requirements: Add a keyword-only parameter extra_paths (default empty tuple) to smoke_import; it is an iterable of path-like external dependency roots.

Compute an effective list `_extra` = [str(p) for p in extra_paths if str(p)]. If `_extra` is empty, fall back to the external working dir: read os.environ.get('JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR'); if it is truthy and `not _target_is_self(<wd>)` (lazy `from harness.paths import _target_is_self`), set `_extra = [str(<wd>)]`; wrap the fallback in try/except so a resolution error leaves `_extra` empty.
Append `_extra` to path_parts (after the existing _site_packages_dirs extend) so it is on PYTHONPATH for the non-jailed subprocess.
On the jailed branch, append `_extra` to the extra_ro list passed to build_jail_argv so each external root is ro-bound into the jail (mirroring the existing site-packages binds).
spec.interfaces: smoke_import(module_name: str, module_src: str, *, timeout: float=5.0, extra_paths: Iterable[str | os.PathLike]=()) -> str | None. _target_is_self is imported lazily in-body; os, pathlib, sys are already module-level. Existing call sites (smoke_import('_smoke_candidate', code)) keep working unchanged.
edge_cases: Explicit extra_paths=[root] where root holds pkg/mod.py and candidate is `from pkg.mod import X` -> import resolves -> returns None.
No extra_paths and no env -> external dep unresolvable -> returns an error string (unchanged behavior for self builds).
No extra_paths but JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR set to an external root -> resolves via the env fallback -> None.
JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR set to a self path (or unset) -> _target_is_self True / absent -> no extra path added; self build unaffected.
extra_paths containing a non-existent path -> build_jail_argv's extra_ro loop skips paths that do not exist (os.path.exists guard); PYTHONPATH entry is harmless.
non_goals: No change to harness/orchestrator_worker.py: the smoke call site needs no edit because the env fallback (JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR, already set on the worker by the daemon gap#3 fix) wires production automatically.
Do not weaken the smoke gate for self builds (no JM-root broadening); the extra paths apply only when explicitly passed or when an EXTERNAL working_dir is in the env.
Do not change the return contract, the fail-closed bwrap branch, the dbus-proxy fail-closed logic, or the bind_credentials=False execute-path posture.
Do not add a new module-level import or top-level symbol; _target_is_self is lazy in-body. Do not use eval/exec/__import__.
integration: this single-function change is pinned solely by the committed oracle tests/harness/test_smoke_import_external_paths.py; no broader wiring is added.
spec.implementation_notes:
Emit a SINGLE kind:'symbol' partial-edit patch via __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ with name 'smoke_import'. The file is in the jail (self build) -> read harness/sandbox_smoke.py and reproduce smoke_import byte-for-byte EXCEPT: (1) the signature gains `, extra_paths: 'Iterable[str | os.PathLike]'=()` after `timeout: float=5.0` (keep the `*` keyword-only marker); add a one-line `extra_paths:` entry to the Args docstring. (2) Right after `mod_path.write_text(...)` and before `env = dict(_WORKER_SCRUB_ENV)`, insert:

        # NGv2 external-build (bug #2): make EXTERNAL dependency roots resolvable
        # so a candidate importing e.g. `ngv2.contracts` (under the external
        # working_dir) smoke-imports cleanly. Explicit extra_paths win; else fall
        # back to JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR when it names an EXTERNAL target (set on
        # the worker by the daemon gap#3 fix). Self builds get nothing (inert).
        _extra = [str(p) for p in extra_paths if str(p)]
        if not _extra:
            try:
                _wd = os.environ.get('JANUSMASK_WORKING_DIR')
                if _wd:
                    from harness.paths import _target_is_self
                    if not _target_is_self(_wd):
                        _extra = [str(_wd)]
            except Exception:
                _extra = []

(3) After `path_parts.extend(_site_packages_dirs())` add `path_parts.extend(_extra)`. (4) In the jailed branch change `extra_ro = [sys.base_prefix, sys.prefix] + _site_packages_dirs()` to `extra_ro = [sys.base_prefix, sys.prefix] + _site_packages_dirs() + _extra`. Keep `from __future__ import annotations` semantics: the annotation `'Iterable[str | os.PathLike]'` is a string so no new import is required (Iterable need not resolve at runtime). Reproduce everything else (the dbus block, the bwrap fail-closed branch, the subprocess.run, the return) verbatim.
